description: Here we have rounded up some of the best smartphones in India with advanced AI camera features. Our list includes top contenders such as the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, iPhone 17 Pro Max and the Google Pixel 10, along with other devices from companies including Vivo and OnePlus. They offer features like Photo Assist, AI Scene Recognition, AI Portrait Enhancement, and AI Night Mode.
title: Best Smartphones With AI Camera Features: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Pixel 10, More

description: Samsung is gearing up to expand its foldable smartphone lineup with the expected launch of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra later this month. Reports have hinted at several upgrades, including a lighter build, a redesigned hinge, flagship cameras and a larger battery. The handset is also expected to ship with One UI 9, new Galaxy AI capabilities and Qualcomm's latest Snapdragon chipset. Ahead of the unveiling, Samsung has started accepting pre-reservations for its upcoming Galaxy foldables in India.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price, Specifications, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 is likely to be launched during the Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22. Here is a quick overview of the launch date, expected pricing, specifications, and features of the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price, Specifications

description: We have rounded up the best TWS earbuds under Rs. 2,000 currently available in India, suitable for basic calling and music listening needs. Our picks include Realme Buds T310 and OnePlus Nord Buds 3r, among others. These models offer clear conversations and longer battery life. They have a low latency rate for gaming and an ANC feature for eliminating disturbances during calls.
title: Best TWS Earbuds Under Rs. 2,000 in India for Calls and Music

description: In recent years, physical SIM cards have gradually given way to eSIM technology. Jio, Vodafone Idea (Vi), and Airtel, the three largest telecom operators in India, offer eSIM functionality for supported devices. Unlike traditional SIM cards, it can be activated digitally. Jio supports eSIM activation on a wide range of compatible Android smartphones, iPhones, tablets, and smartwatches. It also offers an option to convert your physical SIM to eSIM for devices that support it.
title: How to Activate Your Jio eSIM in 2026: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: At the sub-Rs. 40,000 price point, one would expect a more premium-feeling and functioning smartphone. Sadly, this is not the case of mid-range to premium devices in 2026 because of the ongoing memory crisis, which has seen prices rise drastically. From dual rear cameras to budget processors, the sub-Rs. 40,000 segment is going through quite an identity crisis.
title: Best Mobiles Under Rs. 40,000 in India: From Redmi Turbo 5, to OnePlus Nord CE 6 and More
